pages.kwy: Wa lalapo! Ndapanda okakadona ka hafa. Etango oli li nawa.
pages.eng: Good morning! Ndapanda is a happy girl. The sun is shining.

pages.kwy: Ota ende nombwa yaye komuti munene.
pages.eng: She walks with her dog to the big tree.
They drink water and rest. Thank you, nature!
The big elephant is walking in the desert.
He needs a lot of water.

pages.kwy: Oye a mona omeya menono. Ohafi unene!
pages.eng: He found water in the mud. He is very happy!
The elephant plays in the water.

pages.kwy: Etotono oli li onyamakuti i na evelo.
pages.eng: The cheetah is a very fast animal.
She rests in the shade of the tree.
